scope: Bounded official-source search, not an exhaustive global ranking or claim that every item was released today.

candidates.name: Qwen3.8-27B FP8
candidates.memory_caveat: Tensor bytes only; includes packed storage conventions, excludes KV/cache/runtime. Not logical parameter count or a guaranteed load footprint.
candidates.reason: 더 강한 국소 의미 연산자 후보. 27B dense 모델의 실제 품질·지연·예외 보존을 동일 과제로 비교.
candidates.qualification: 기존 35B 서비스를 대체하는 격리 창에서 비교; FP8 GB10 경로와 가중치 외 KV/runtime 여유를 먼저 검증.

candidates.name: NVIDIA Qwen3.6-35B-A3B NVFP4
candidates.memory_caveat: Tensor bytes only; includes packed storage conventions, excludes KV/cache/runtime. Not logical parameter count or a guaranteed load footprint.
candidates.reason: NVIDIA가 DGX Spark용으로 직접 제시하는 양자화·서빙 후보.
candidates.qualification: 현재 FP8와 동일 모델 계열의 품질 손실, 안정성, 처리량·메모리를 비교. 제조사 속도 수치를 우리 측정으로 취급하지 않음.

candidates.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
candidates.memory_caveat: Tensor bytes only; includes packed storage conventions, excludes KV/cache/runtime. Not logical parameter count or a guaranteed load footprint.
candidates.reason: 2026-09-10 공개된 CED·CSA2·압축 KV·Engram 설계의 최신 비교 문헌.
candidates.qualification: 552B backbone/763B tensor inventory로 이 단일 DGX에 상주시키는 후보에서 제외. API 실험은 현재 수행하지 않음.

candidates.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
candidates.memory_caveat: Tensor bytes only; includes packed storage conventions, excludes KV/cache/runtime. Not logical parameter count or a guaranteed load footprint.
candidates.reason: 320B total/18B active, sparse+linear attention의 최신 비교 모델.
candidates.qualification: FP8 전체 가중치는 DGX 메모리를 초과. 활성 파라미터 수를 적재 용량으로 오인하지 않음.

candidates.name: vLLM 0.29.0
candidates.reason: 공식 2026-09-09 release; 현재 서버 0.25.1과 구분. JSON Schema 출력 제한은 기존 서버에서 바로 실험.
candidates.qualification: GB10 FP8 장문/동시성/예외 출력 회귀를 통과한 뒤 운영 교체. 0.29가 관측 오류를 고쳤다는 주장은 아직 불가.

candidates.name: GEPA 0.1.4
candidates.reason: 관측 실패를 반영하는 의미 텍스트 후보 생성·선택 비교에 적합.
candidates.qualification: 동일 모델 호출/토큰 예산에서 단일 수정·feedback-only·GEPA 비교. 제안 생성만 맡기고 canonical 쓰기는 native admission이 담당.

candidates.name: UnifiedMem
candidates.reason: 그래프/비그래프 기억의 구현 조건을 맞추는 비교 참고.
candidates.qualification: 공식 저장소에서 SPDX 라이선스를 확인하지 못했으므로 코드 도입 보류. 대화 기억 성능은 HSWM 전체 AI 증거가 아님.

candidates.name: Inspect AI 0.3.266
candidates.reason: HSWM 런타임과 별도로 과제·scorer·trace를 관리할 외부 평가 후보.
candidates.qualification: 기존 typed runtime을 대체하지 않고 평가 경계를 분리; 외부 데이터와 scorer 검증 후 작은 비교부터 시작.

candidates.name: Hyperon experimental 0.2.10
candidates.reason: 영속 metagraph·MeTTa·neural bridge의 직접 선행. 현재 확인한 tag는 기존 감사와 동일.
candidates.qualification: 구성요소별 성숙도와 정확한 구현 버전을 유지. 이번 합성 실험은 Hyperon 성능 비교를 수행하지 않음.

papers.title: GABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Graph Analysis Tasks
papers.finding: 84 executable tools and 10,400 verifiable tasks across graph retrieval, theory, ML and open-ended QA.
papers.transfer: Independent graph-operation benchmark candidate, not proof of hypergraph state learning. Dataset/code license and immutable revision still need qualification.

papers.title: Does Memory Need Graphs? A Unified Framework and Empirical Analysis for Long-Term Dialog Memory
papers.finding: Controlled LongMemEval/HaluMem comparisons find that graph construction, value granularity and retrieval choices can determine whether graphs help or hurt.
papers.transfer: Require strong flat-memory and feedback-only controls. Findings concern dialog memory, not a refutation or validation of HSWM identity.

papers.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
papers.finding: Reflective natural-language mutations and Pareto selection improve studied task prompts with fewer rollouts than reported comparison methods.
papers.transfer: A proposal-search comparator; no paper result establishes outcome-bound HSWM efficacy or general superiority.

papers.title: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
papers.finding: 125B/6B MoE plus 51B host embedding tables; combines hybrid attention, gated residuals and training ablations.
papers.transfer: Architecture/efficiency reference for Flash-Next, not the development paper of the distinct dense Qwen3.8-27B candidate.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
papers.finding: Vendor reports CED encoder/decoder splitting, CSA2 KV sharing, FP4 KV, Engram memory and SFT/RL/on-policy distillation.
papers.transfer: Inference-memory architecture reference; not a local deployment or an HSWM effectiveness result.

adopted_here: Existing native Effect durable semantic runtime for actual LLM prediction/revision/reopen
Existing vLLM JSON Schema structured output in separately frozen v3 condition
Existing RDF 1.1/PROV-O/SHACL projection with exact sources and distinct evidence status
source_boundary: Upstream reports are diagnostic comparisons, not independent proof of the exact local root cause.
